# EOG Resources (EOG) and Enterprise Products Partners (EPD) Deep Dive Analysis

Report 064 | Published 2021-08-08 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-8-8/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/064.json)

Inflation, crypto, and energy balance sheets.

The report correctly emphasized persistent inflation and rent pressure while energy selections had favorable absolute sensitivities. EOG lagged the stock it replaced, however. ETH absolute returns disappointed at both six and twelve months, and the issuance explanation conflated London with the later Merge. Policy and legal scenarios need narrower causal and institutional claims.

**Coverage:** Read blocks 0-248 and all 32 image labels. Covers medical/economic assumptions, policy plumbing, gold, BTC/ETH, EOG/EPD and health insurers. Personal anecdote and incidental company descriptions excluded.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Severe outcomes after vaccination](https://www.cdc.gov/mmwr/volumes/71/wr/mm7101a4.htm) | CDC | 2022-01-07 | Verified in the audit

Among 1,228,664 vaccinated adults, 189 had severe outcomes and 36 died; older age, immunosuppression and other conditions raised risk. All severe cases had at least one risk factor. Findings do not generalize automatically to future variants.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Deductive assessment:**

- Market clears
- Fixed available supply S
- Demand D(p) varies with preferences

Equilibrium solves D(p)=S. Changing D while holding S fixed changes p; S alone does not determine p.
